title: Animals & Their Needs
description: Grade 1 Science: animals all around us! What animals need, their homes, what they eat, baby animals and how they move — with interactive games and an animal-watch activity.

topics.title: What Animals Need
topics.concept:
Animals are living things, just like plants and people. To stay alive and healthy, every animal needs:

  • 🍎 Food — for energy to move and grow.
  • 💧 Water — to drink.
  • 🌬️ Air — to breathe.
  • 🏠 Shelter — a safe home to rest and hide.

From the biggest elephant to the tiniest ant, all animals need these same four things.

recap: Every animal needs food, water, air and shelter.
Big or small, animals share the same basic needs.

wonder.text: You need food, water and a home. Do you think a tiny ant needs the same things?

qa.a: Yes — but in a clever way! Fish use parts called gills to take in the air that is mixed inside the water. So they breathe without ever coming up!
A shelter keeps animals safe from rain, heat, cold and other animals. It is their cosy, safe home — just like your house keeps you safe.

topics.title: Animal Homes
topics.concept:
Animals live in many different kinds of homes. Each home keeps that animal safe:

  • 🐦 A bird lives in a nest.
  • 🐝 Bees live in a hive.
  • 🕷️ A spider waits in its web.
  • 🐀 Some animals dig a burrow under the ground.
  • 🦁 A lion rests in a den.
topics.visual: <svg viewBox="0 0 330 155" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="330" height="155" fill="#fff7ea"/><text x="55" y="68" font-size="38" text-anchor="middle">🐦</text><text x="55" y="114" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Nest</text><text x="165" y="68" font-size="38" text-anchor="middle">🐝</text><text x="165" y="114" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Hive</text><text x="275" y="68" font-size="38" text-anchor="middle">🕷️</text><text x="275" y="114" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Web</text><text x="165" y="142" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#555" text-anchor="middle">Animal homes</text></svg>
recap: Animals live in homes that keep them safe.
Bird → nest, bee → hive, spider → web, lion → den.
Some animals dig a burrow under the ground.

wonder.text: A bird builds a nest, a bee makes a hive. Can you guess who lives in a web?

qa.q: Do all animals build their own homes?
qa.a: Many do! Birds build nests, bees build hives and spiders spin webs. Some animals, like hermit crabs, borrow an empty shell instead.
Pet dogs often live with us in our homes, or in a little house called a kennel. We become their family and keep them safe.

topics.title: What Animals Eat
topics.concept:
Animals do not all eat the same things. We can sort them into groups:

  • 🌿 Plant-eaters — like cow, deer and rabbit. They eat grass, leaves and fruit.
  • 🍖 Meat-eaters — like lion, tiger and eagle. They eat other animals.
  • 🍎🍖 Both — like bears, crows and people! They eat plants and meat.
topics.visual: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 155" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="320" height="155" fill="#fff"/><rect x="10" y="14" width="146" height="124" rx="14" fill="#e6f3d8"/><text x="50" y="78" font-size="36" text-anchor="middle">🐄</text><text x="106" y="78" font-size="36" text-anchor="middle">🐰</text><text x="83" y="120" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Eats plants</text><rect x="164" y="14" width="146" height="124" rx="14" fill="#ffe0d8"/><text x="204" y="78" font-size="36" text-anchor="middle">🦁</text><text x="260" y="78" font-size="36" text-anchor="middle">🐅</text><text x="237" y="120" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Eats meat</text></svg>
recap: Some, like bears and people, eat both.

wonder.text: A cow munches grass all day, but a lion hunts. Why do they eat such different food?

qa.q: What do we call animals that eat only plants?
qa.a: We call them herbivores (say: HER-bi-vores). A cow is a herbivore because it eats only grass and plants.
Most humans eat both! We enjoy fruits and vegetables (plants) and also things like eggs, fish or meat. Animals that eat both are called omnivores.

topics.title: Animal Babies
topics.concept:
Just like you were once a baby, animals have babies too — and many baby animals have special names!

  • 🐕 Dog → puppy
  • 🐈 Cat → kitten
  • 🐄 Cow → calf
  • 🐔 Hen → chick
  • 🐸 Frog → tadpole

Some babies look just like their parents, only smaller. But a tadpole looks nothing like a frog — it grows legs and changes as it gets bigger!
topics.visual: <svg viewBox="0 0 330 155" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="330" height="155" fill="#fff0f0"/><text x="55" y="68" font-size="38" text-anchor="middle">🐶</text><text x="55" y="114" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Puppy</text><text x="165" y="68" font-size="38" text-anchor="middle">🐱</text><text x="165" y="114" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Kitten</text><text x="275" y="68" font-size="38" text-anchor="middle">🐤</text><text x="275" y="114" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Chick</text><text x="165" y="142" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#555" text-anchor="middle">Animal babies</text></svg>
recap: Many baby animals have special names.
A frog's baby is a tadpole — it changes a lot as it grows.

wonder.text: A baby dog is a puppy. Do you know what a baby cow is called?

qa.q: Why does a tadpole look so different from a frog?
qa.a: A tadpole lives in water and has a tail to swim. As it grows it slowly grows legs, loses its tail, and turns into a frog that can hop on land. Amazing!
Baby mammals — like puppies, kittens and calves — drink milk from their mothers. Baby birds are fed by their parents instead.

topics.title: How Animals Move
topics.concept:
Animals move in many different ways to find food and stay safe:

  • 🚶 Walk / run — dog, horse, elephant
  • 🦅 Fly — birds, bats, butterflies
  • 🐟 Swim — fish, dolphins, ducks
  • 🐛 Crawl / slide — snakes, worms, snails
  • 🐰 Hop / jump — rabbits, frogs, kangaroos
topics.visual: <svg viewBox="0 0 360 155" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="360" height="155" fill="#eef6ff"/><text x="45" y="68" font-size="38" text-anchor="middle">🚶</text><text x="45" y="114" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Walk</text><text x="135" y="68" font-size="38" text-anchor="middle">🦅</text><text x="135" y="114" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Fly</text><text x="225" y="68" font-size="38" text-anchor="middle">🐟</text><text x="225" y="114" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Swim</text><text x="315" y="68" font-size="38" text-anchor="middle">🐰</text><text x="315" y="114" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Hop</text><text x="180" y="142" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#555" text-anchor="middle">How animals move</text></svg>
recap: Animals move to find food and stay safe.
Ways to move: walk, fly, swim, crawl/slide, hop.
Some animals (like ducks) can move in more than one way.

wonder.text: A fish swims, a bird flies, a snake slides. How many ways to move can you think of?

qa.q: Can any animal move in more than one way?
qa.a: Yes! A duck can walk on land, swim in water AND fly in the air. A frog can both hop and swim. Clever animals!

qa.q: How do snakes move without legs?
qa.a: Snakes have no legs, so they slide along the ground by curving and pushing their bodies. This wiggly movement is called slithering.

questions.q: What do all animals need to live?
questions.explanation: Every animal needs food, water, air and a safe shelter.
Birds build nests to live in and to keep their eggs safe.
A cow is a plant-eater — it eats grass and leaves.

questions.q: A baby dog is called a…
questions.explanation: A baby dog is a puppy.

questions.q: How does a fish move in water?
questions.explanation: Fish swim using their fins and tail.

questions.q: Which animal lives in a hive?
questions.explanation: Bees live together in a hive.

questions.q: A baby cow is called a…
questions.explanation: A baby cow is called a calf.

questions.q: Which animal can move in MORE than one way?
questions.explanation: A duck can walk on land, swim in water and fly in the air.

questions.q: Animals that eat both plants and meat are called…
questions.explanation: Animals that eat both plants and meat (like bears and people) are omnivores.

questions.q: How does a fish breathe under water?
questions.explanation: Fish use gills to take in the air mixed in the water.

questions.q: Put in order — which comes FIRST in a butterfly's life?
questions.explanation: The order is egg → caterpillar → cocoon → butterfly.
